build_DeepTDLearning: build a DeepTDLearning policy learner with a custom Q-value network and AdamW optimizer
act_DeepTDLearning: act using the DeepTDLearning policy to select an action balancing exploration and exploitation
implement_get_next_state_values: implement the abstract get_next_state_values method to compute Q-value targets for the Bellman equation
forward_DeepTDLearning: forward pass through the Q-network to compute Q-values for a batch of transitions
learn_batch_DeepTDLearning: learn from a batch of transitions using TD(0) style updates with backpropagation
